enemies.name: Footprint Chaser
enemies.flavor: A hearse that refuses to pass you.
enemies.behavior: Follows your old footprints and lunges when you stop. Keep moving forward; dash sideways at the toll.

enemies.name: Orbit Dasher
enemies.flavor: A thrown knife that learned hunger.
enemies.behavior: Orbits, then dashes in a straight line at you. Sidestep when its aim line freezes; pillars stop the dash.

enemies.name: Stillness Shrieker
enemies.flavor: A million motes that hush the world to hear you stop.
enemies.behavior: Marks the fastest player and shrieks if they move. Stand still until its ring snaps shut.

enemies.name: Wall Drifter
enemies.flavor: A doorway from a dead world, still holding its post.
enemies.behavior: Drifts through walls and shoves everything away from it. Fight it on wide ground, never on a bridge.

enemies.name: Shell Bomber
enemies.flavor: The wind between platforms, loaded with a grudge.
enemies.behavior: Drops marked shells from above that explode on the floor. Move off the circle or hide under a bridge.

enemies.name: Gift Stinger
enemies.flavor: Its light is a promise it never intends to keep.
enemies.behavior: Flies to the gift you just picked up and stings anyone near it. Step away and let it gorge on nothing.

enemies.name: Bolt Turret
enemies.flavor: It has been aiming at this spot since before you arrived.
enemies.behavior: Never moves; charges a bolt along a line it predicts. Break line of sight, then peek while it vents.

enemies.name: False Gift
enemies.flavor: It has been a gift for a long time, and it is patient.
enemies.behavior: Sits still as a gift, then lunges when you come close. Dash through it to reveal it from safety.

enemies.name: Floor Rotter
enemies.flavor: Where it drifts, the floor forgets how to be a floor.
enemies.behavior: Rots the floor under you: slowed, no abilities. Cross fast and loot somewhere else.

enemies.name: Path Replayer
enemies.flavor: It walks where you walked, a beat late.
enemies.behavior: Replays the nearest player's path from 1.5 s ago; touching it kills. Change direction or take a pad.

enemies.name: Gift Guard
enemies.flavor: It has decided which gift is its own.
enemies.behavior: Guards the densest gift cluster and lunges at whoever takes one. Be outside its ring when it closes.

enemies.name: Bell Ringer
enemies.flavor: Three rings. Only the last one matters.
enemies.behavior: Rings three times beside the closest player. Harmless unless you are Overtuned, then it kills.

enemies.name: Tether Tracker
enemies.flavor: It has already decided where you will be.
enemies.behavior: Locks the player farthest from the group and blasts a tracked marker. Keep moving; break its line.

enemies.name: Fog Dasher
enemies.flavor: You will hear it before you see it. Barely.
enemies.behavior: Hides in its own fog, dashes, strikes, then vanishes and reappears beside the next-closest player.

enemies.name: Ground Infector
enemies.flavor: The floor is the enemy.
enemies.behavior: Infects the ground you cross; the infection slows you and pauses Rewind's and Kite's timers.

enemies.name: Beat Keeper
enemies.flavor: It counts. You answer on the number.
enemies.behavior: A beacon counts up. Use your class ability exactly on your number or be struck.

enemies.name: Marking Eye
enemies.flavor: It only ever looks at one of you.
enemies.behavior: Marks one player and fires a slow tracking laser only they can see. Break its line of sight.

enemies.name: Choir Summoner
enemies.flavor: The singing stops when you take its instruments.
enemies.behavior: Instruments spawn as gifts; each one you collect freezes the choir and extends its timer.

enemies.name: Spring Leaper
enemies.flavor: It winds while you stand there.
enemies.behavior: Winds tighter while you stay near, then leaps and leaves you Overtuned. Leave before it is wound.

enemies.name: Fog Decoy
enemies.flavor: It glows like a gift. It is not a gift.
enemies.behavior: Sits in fog glowing like a gift. Step close and it flares, shocks you back and hunts you.

upgrades.name: Zephyr Tread
upgrades.flavor: Soles that remember running before the fall.

upgrades.name: Skyhook Arc
upgrades.flavor: The apex of every jump, held a heartbeat longer.

upgrades.name: Gossamer Descent
upgrades.flavor: Gravity loosens its grip, one breath at a time.

upgrades.name: Dashspur Lash
upgrades.flavor: A whipcrack behind the heels, quickening the burst.

upgrades.name: Ember Rewind
upgrades.flavor: The cooldown burns away like a struck match.

upgrades.name: Twin Feather
upgrades.flavor: Two bright downs left behind by something kinder.

upgrades.name: Lantern Magnet
upgrades.flavor: Gifts lean toward your reaching hand on their own.

upgrades.name: Spare Wick
upgrades.flavor: A second flame, kept for the fall you never see.

upgrades.name: Thinning Shroud
upgrades.flavor: The mist politely forgets to hide the way.

upgrades.name: Beaconflare
upgrades.flavor: The exit beacon burns brighter for your coming.

curses.name: Leadened Soles
curses.flavor: Every step lands like it owes the ground interest.

curses.name: Heavy Air
curses.flavor: Invisible hands press the sky onto your shoulders.

curses.name: Waning Reflex
curses.flavor: The spark between thought and dash gutters.

curses.name: Numb Fingers
curses.flavor: Your hands forget the shape of holding.

curses.name: Closing Mist
curses.flavor: The world shrinks to an arm's length of grey.

curses.name: Hungering Pace
curses.flavor: Somewhere behind you, footsteps quicken in time with yours.

curses.name: Far Senses
curses.flavor: The void's eyes open wider, and further.

curses.name: Rude Awakening
curses.flavor: The things that sleep, wake before you'd like.

curses.name: Swarm Seed
curses.flavor: One more of them. There is always one more of them.

curses.name: The Hollow Choir
curses.flavor: Every voice in the dark sings your route aloud.

curses.name: Leaden Sky
curses.flavor: The firmament itself has taken against you.

curses.name: World of Teeth
curses.flavor: The whole void grinds a little closer, always.

curses.name: Clustered Gifts
curses.flavor: The heaps lean toward each other in the dark, like bad gossip.
curses.effect: gifts cluster tighter: -40% minimum gift spacing

curses.name: Wreath
curses.flavor: Something lays a cold ring on your head and begins to grieve for you.
curses.effect: a wreath cries on a player; pad or glider shakes it off

curses.name: Tithe
curses.flavor: Every gift you lift is weighed, and something takes its cut.
curses.effect: each gift costs 1 currency; at zero you are slowed

curses.name: Hush
curses.flavor: The fog leans in close and puts a finger to its lips.
curses.effect: gift hint off, fog thickens; radar or a callout counters it

curses.name: Spring Floor
curses.flavor: The ground has decided to throw you somewhere else.
curses.effect: more trampolines in every generated level

curses.name: Minefield
curses.flavor: Someone has been very busy under the floorboards.
curses.effect: tripmines appear in every generated level

classes.name: Striker
classes.flavor: You were made to close the gap, not to hold it.
classes.ability: Dash a short burst forward, then wait out the cooldown.

classes.name: Grappler
classes.flavor: The void is a wall you have learned to pull against.
classes.ability: Fire an auto-aimed grapple that pulls you to the platform ahead.
classes.controls: Shift / right mouse: grapple the platform ahead

classes.name: Bulwark
classes.flavor: You do not dodge the storm. You become the doorway it breaks against.
classes.ability: Root for 1.6 s, shove everything nearby away; only falling shells can still hurt you.
classes.controls: Shift / right mouse: raise the ward (on the ground)

classes.name: Glider
classes.flavor: Falling is only a slower kind of flight.
classes.ability: Jump once more in mid-air, and hold the ability key while falling to glide.
classes.controls: Space in mid-air: extra jump; hold Shift / right mouse: glide

shop.name: Kept Flame
shop.flavor: A light left burning for a fall that has not happened yet.
shop.effect: +1 life; you respawn at the level start

shop.name: New Hand
shop.flavor: The cards were never yours. Ask again.
shop.effect: Reroll the reward cards offered this lobby

shop.name: Worn Treads
shop.flavor: Old soles, already broken in by someone faster.
shop.effect: +8% run speed for the rest of the run

shop.name: Spring Heel
shop.flavor: A small coil of tension under each step.
shop.effect: +6% jump velocity for the rest of the run

shop.name: Short Fuse
shop.flavor: The dash comes back before you miss it.
shop.effect: -10% dash cooldown for the rest of the run

shop.name: Wide Palm
shop.flavor: Your reach grows a finger's width at a time.
shop.effect: +15% gift pickup reach for the rest of the run

shop.name: Thin Veil
shop.flavor: The mist thins where you look hardest.
shop.effect: -12% fog density for the rest of the run

shop.name: Striker's Rhythm
shop.flavor: The dash was never a burst. It was a decision.
shop.effect: -12% dash cooldown for the rest of the run

shop.name: Longshore Rhythm
shop.flavor: Every pull is a step you did not have to take.
shop.effect: +10% run speed for the rest of the run

shop.name: Still Water
shop.flavor: The storm breaks on you, and learns to go quiet.
shop.effect: enemies sense you 25% shorter for the rest of the run

shop.name: Tailwind Lungs
shop.flavor: One breath more than the fall was promised.
shop.effect: +1 air jump for the rest of the run

shop.name: Spurred Heels
shop.flavor: The hearse cannot toll a runner who never stops.
shop.effect: Helps against the Footprint Chaser: +12% dash speed

shop.name: Eyed Parries
shop.flavor: You have watched the freeze a hundred times. It always telegraphs.
shop.effect: Helps against the Orbit Dasher: -15% dash cooldown

shop.name: Muted Bells
shop.flavor: Pad your footfalls; let the hush find nothing.
shop.effect: Helps against the Stillness Shrieker: -25% enemy aggro

shop.name: Sea Anchor
shop.flavor: When the walls push, lean the other way.
shop.effect: Helps against the Wall Drifter: +12% run speed

shop.name: Farsight Draught
shop.flavor: See the circle before it becomes the ground.
shop.effect: Helps against the Shell Bomber: -25% fog density

shop.name: Leaden Net
shop.flavor: Tangle the light before it reaches the gift.
shop.effect: Helps against the Gift Stinger: enemies move 15% slower

shop.name: Flicker Treads
shop.flavor: It predicts where you will be. Be elsewhere.
shop.effect: Helps against the Bolt Turret: +20% dash speed

shop.name: Quickdraw Charm
shop.flavor: The gift flinches first. Now so can you.
shop.effect: Helps against the False Gift: -15% dash cooldown

shop.name: Clean Boots
shop.flavor: The rot forgets a foot that never slows.
shop.effect: Helps against the Floor Rotter: +12% run speed

shop.name: Crosswind Pivot
shop.flavor: Walk your own line, but refuse to repeat it.
shop.effect: Helps against the Path Replayer: +15% jump velocity

shop.name: Soft Soles
shop.flavor: Take the gift; leave no footprint worth striking.
shop.effect: Helps against the Gift Guard: enemies sense you 30% shorter

shop.name: Soft Bellwax
shop.flavor: Muffle the ringing before the third bell.
shop.effect: Helps against the Bell Ringer: enemies move 15% slower

shop.name: Tailwind Sail
shop.flavor: The farthest runner catches the kinder wind.
shop.effect: Helps against the Tether Tracker: +12% run speed

shop.name: Clear Draught
shop.flavor: Thin its fog; watch it dash before it disappears.
shop.effect: Helps against the Fog Dasher: -30% fog density

shop.name: Salt and Ash
shop.flavor: Scar the ground behind you; let the infection starve.
shop.effect: Helps against the Ground Infector: +12% run speed

shop.name: Syncopated Heart
shop.flavor: The beacon counts. Your heart refuses the beat.
shop.effect: Helps against the Beat Keeper: -15% dash cooldown

shop.name: Grey Veil
shop.flavor: Wear the fog it watches through.
shop.effect: Helps against the Marking Eye: -25% fog density

shop.name: Quiet Pockets
shop.flavor: Applaud softly. Never on the beat.
shop.effect: Helps against the Choir Summoner: -25% enemy aggro

shop.name: Loose Springs
shop.flavor: Unwind it before it unwinds you.
shop.effect: Helps against the Spring Leaper: +15% dash speed

shop.name: True Lantern
shop.flavor: A light that does not promise. Look closer.
shop.effect: Helps against the Fog Decoy: -30% fog density

shop.name: Gift Compass
shop.flavor: It points at what you have not taken, never at what is pretending.
shop.effect: arrow to the nearest gift, with distance

shop.name: Hunter Ping
shop.flavor: A short knock on the dark. Something always knocks back.
shop.effect: ping permanent enemies every 10 s

shop.name: Ground Sense
shop.flavor: The floor has opinions about where you should stand.
shop.effect: reveals nearby ground hazards

events.name: High Rise
events.banner: The platforms climb higher and the gaps run wider.

events.name: Slick Ice
events.banner: Every floor is ice: you slide and stop slowly.

events.name: Crumbling
events.banner: Platforms crumble underfoot; keep moving forward.

milestones.name: The Void Collapses
milestones.banner: Grab the gold and get back to the beacon before the floor is gone.

milestones.name: Ashen Unlock
milestones.banner: Ashen bridges open; one more of the most-voted enemy joins the hunt.

milestones.name: Tall Order
milestones.banner: The tall silos open, and the Stillness Shrieker's hush tightens to 1.8 s.

milestones.name: Crowded Wake
milestones.banner: One more Footprint Chaser wakes; every drafted enemy gains a copy every 3 levels.

milestones.name: Catwalk Season
milestones.banner: The narrow catwalks open above the void.

milestones.name: Bombardier
milestones.banner: The Shell Bomber drops three shells instead of two.

milestones.name: Short Warning
milestones.banner: Tiles warn for 2 s instead of 3 s before they fall.

milestones.name: Second Front
milestones.banner: Every 2 drafted enemy types add a copy; greater curses reach the shop.

milestones.name: Grey Tide
milestones.banner: Fog thickens by a quarter; the far platforms go grey.

milestones.name: Swifter Wake
milestones.banner: The Footprint Chaser hunts at 6.0 u/s instead of 5.2.

milestones.name: Elder Models
milestones.banner: Orbit Dasher locks in 0.60 s; the Bolt Turret charges in 0.80 s.

milestones.name: Hunger
milestones.banner: The collapse runs 3 s shorter; the floor still holds 30 s at least.

milestones.name: Deep Night
milestones.banner: The False Gift shimmers every 2.2 s; fog rises another 15%.

milestones.name: Full Chorus
milestones.banner: Every drafted enemy gains a copy; altars rise to 5 a level.

milestones.name: Endless
milestones.banner: Past level 25 the collapse loses 1 s a level; enemies gain 5% speed every 5 levels.

altars.name: Shortcut Altar
altars.flavor: A door that skips the argument, and sends the bill ahead.
altars.effect: Benefit: skip the next draft and go straight to the shop. Cost: two temporary curses and two extra enemies next level.

altars.name: Gift Sight Altar
altars.flavor: For one level, every gift burns through the dark.
altars.effect: Benefit: every gift is highlighted this level. Cost: the next draft's reward cards come from the hardest pool.

altars.name: Clear Sky Altar
altars.flavor: The mist parts. Something was waiting in it.
altars.effect: Benefit: this level's fog is cleared. Cost: Lure and Static spawn at the altar immediately.

altars.name: Debt Altar
altars.flavor: It lends generously, and it remembers.
altars.effect: Benefit: gain 30 currency now. Cost: the next two levels' golden-gift income repays the debt; any remainder is taken from your purse.

achievements.name: Out of the Fog
achievements.description: Break out of a Lure's pursuit.

achievements.name: Landslide
achievements.description: Win a pedestal vote 5-1 or better.

achievements.name: Untouched
achievements.description: Clear a level without anyone dying.

achievements.name: Completionist
achievements.description: Collect every gift on a level.

achievements.name: Extremist
achievements.description: Finish a run in EXTREME mode.
